text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
{0} and Djeeta find themselves busier than ever
thanks to the amount of job offers they have been receiving.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ジータと{0}は、
騎空団へ仕事の依頼が増えたため、多忙の日々を送っていた。

text_block_list.name: Djeeta
text_block_list.text:
Phew... Having work's good and all,
but it's getting kind of tough with just the two of us.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふぅ……
仕事があるのはありがたいけど、
二人だけだと、
やっぱりちょっと大変だね。

text_block_list.name: Djeeta
text_block_list.text:
We're probably gonna have to start balancing
how much we take on. Otherwise we'll end up
working ourselves beyond exhaustion.
text_block_list.orig_text:
これだけの仕事量は、
いつもは受けられないなぁ……
私とあなたじゃなかったら、
きっと今頃二人とも倒れちゃってるよ。

text_block_list.name: Woman
text_block_list.text: Hey. You're Djeeta, aren't you?
text_block_list.orig_text:
──ねぇ、
あなたがジータ？　
ちょっといいかしら？

text_block_list.name: Djeeta
text_block_list.text: That's me. Is there something I can help you with?
text_block_list.orig_text:
私ですか？　
なんでしょう……？

text_block_list.name: Woman
text_block_list.text:
That's right. I've heard a lot about you and your crew.
Enough so that I spent the whole day
running about trying to find you, in fact.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ええそうよ。
騎空士のジータ。
そしてあなたたちは騎空団でしょう？
今日は話したいことがあって、
ずっと探していたのよ。

text_block_list.name: Djeeta
text_block_list.text: This sure doesn't sound like a job offer, at the very least.
text_block_list.orig_text:
仕事の相談……
じゃなさそうですね。

text_block_list.name: Woman
text_block_list.text:
You're right... is what I'd like to say, but it's technically related.
I'll be blunt. How does joining our guild sound?
text_block_list.orig_text:
その通り……
と言いたいところだけど、
ある意味仕事の相談よ。
……あなたたち、
私たちのギルドへ入ってくれない？

text_block_list.name: Djeeta
text_block_list.text:
Well then. That makes se—
Wait, what?! Wh-what's this all about?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
なるほど。
ギルドに……
……ええっ！？　
ど、
どういうことですか？

text_block_list.name: Woman
text_block_list.text:
Makes sense that you'd be surprised. Let me clarify, though.
This isn't a show of pity for a crew without an airship.
Far from it, in fact.
text_block_list.orig_text:
驚くのも無理はないわ。
まず誤解しないで欲しいんだけど、
あなたたちが騎空艇を持っていない騎空団だからって、
憐れんで誘ってるわけじゃないの。

text_block_list.name: Djeeta
text_block_list.text: Ahaha... H-holding back no punches, are we?
text_block_list.orig_text:
あはは……
ちょ、
直球ですね。

text_block_list.name: Man
text_block_list.text:
Our guild passed the
fifty member mark just recently.
text_block_list.orig_text:
俺たちのギルドの
メンバーはこの間50人を超えたところだ。

text_block_list.name: Djeeta
text_block_list.text: F-fifty?!

text_block_list.name: Woman
text_block_list.text:
We travel all over the place, taking on various jobs wherever
we stop. In fact, we'll be leaving here the day after tomorrow.
text_block_list.orig_text:
私たちは幾つもの馬車で、
各地を旅しながら仕事を受けるの。
この街も明後日には発つ予定よ。

text_block_list.name: Man
text_block_list.text:
That includes hunting down vicious monsters,
escorting large groups of merchants, all that good stuff.
It's tough work, but the pay is more than worth it.
text_block_list.orig_text:
仕事は巨大な魔物の討伐、
大規模な隊商の護衛と様々だ。
厳しい仕事ばかりだが、
その分稼ぎはいい。

text_block_list.name: Djeeta
text_block_list.text:
Makes sense. The tougher the job,
the better the pay is.
text_block_list.orig_text:
たしかに、
それだけの仕事になれば、
報酬もかなりの額になりますね……

text_block_list.name: Woman
text_block_list.text:
As you can guess, every day poses a new kind of danger to us.
And that, in turn, means we can't let anyone and everyone in.
We don't have the leeway to support those that can't keep up.
text_block_list.orig_text:
おかげでいつも危険と隣り合わせなの。
だからこそ、
メンバーの選定は厳正に行う必要があるわ。
ついてこられないメンバーを養えるほど余裕がなくて。

text_block_list.name: Man
text_block_list.text:
Now for the main point. We've heard plenty about you.
And we've judged that you pass our standards with flying colors.
Moreso considering you've done so much with only two of you.
text_block_list.orig_text:
君たちは最近の活躍から、
勝手ながら、
その選定基準を超えていると判断させてもらった。
たった二人ながら、
素晴らしい結果を残しているね。

text_block_list.name: Djeeta
text_block_list.text: Ehehe. Thank you.
text_block_list.orig_text:
えへへ……
ありがとうございます。

text_block_list.name: Woman
text_block_list.text:
Which brings us back to the question.
We'd love to have you in our guild.
text_block_list.orig_text:
そんなあなたと相棒の君には、
ぜひ私たちのギルドに入って欲しいの。

text_block_list.name: Man
text_block_list.text:
It works out for both parties, too.
We get two new, reliable members,
while you can make much more money. Sounds good, right?
text_block_list.orig_text:
俺たちにとっては戦力の拡充になる。
君たちは報酬の額が増える。
お互いにとっていい話だと思うんだが、
どうかな？

text_block_list.name: Djeeta
text_block_list.text:
Err, umm...
I have to be honest, this kind of hit me out of nowhere...
text_block_list.orig_text:
えっと、
あの……
いきなりすぎて、
どう考えたらいいのか分からなくて……

text_block_list.name: Woman
text_block_list.text:
Take some time to think about it. We'll wait.
See you later.
text_block_list.orig_text:
返事はすぐじゃなくて構わないわ。
それじゃあまた。

text_block_list.name: Djeeta
text_block_list.text:
And off they go...
I'm kind of at a loss here.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……行っちゃった。
どうしよう……

text_block_list.name: Djeeta
text_block_list.text: I'm... gonna go home for today.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……私、
今日は帰るね。

text_block_list.name: Djeeta
text_block_list.text:
They made the effort to come invite us,
so it's only fair that I think it through properly.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あの人たちがちゃんと誘ってくれたから、
私もちゃんと答えを出さないと。

text_block_list.name: Djeeta
text_block_list.text:
This is about our future, too. So even more so.
But yeah, see you tomorrow!
text_block_list.orig_text:
だから、
しばらく考えてみる。これからのこと。
それじゃあ、
またね！

text_block_list.name: Djeeta
text_block_list.text:
*sigh* 
I dunno what to do...
text_block_list.orig_text:
……はぁ……
どうしよう……

text_block_list.name: Djeeta
text_block_list.text:
Getting scouted by a guild like that is the last thing I expected...
They've got the reputation too,
so we'd be able to do all sorts of big jobs with them.
text_block_list.orig_text:
まさかあんなに大きなギルドに誘われるなんて……
あの人たちと一緒なら、
きっと今よりも大きな仕事を受けられる……

text_block_list.name: Djeeta
text_block_list.text:
And we'd be travelling around a lot too,
which makes finding leads on {0}'s memories easier.
text_block_list.orig_text:
色んな場所を旅する仕事になるから、
{0}の記憶の手がかりも、
今より見つかりやすくなる……

text_block_list.name: Djeeta
text_block_list.text:
We'd have to disband the crew,
but joining them seems like the best way to achieve our goals...
text_block_list.orig_text:
私たちの目的を実現したいなら、
騎空団を解散して、
ギルドに入ったほうがいいんじゃ……

text_block_list.name: Djeeta
text_block_list.text:
It'd be the fastest way, at the very least.
So why am I being so indecisive about it?
text_block_list.orig_text:
そのほうが近道、
だよね……
でも私、
なんでこんなに悩んでるの……？

text_block_list.name: Djeeta
text_block_list.text: H-how come you're here?
text_block_list.orig_text:
どうして、
あなたがここに……？

text_block_list.name: Djeeta
text_block_list.text: Thanks. As reliable as always, aren't you?
text_block_list.orig_text:
……ありがとう。
相変わらず頼りになる団員だね。

text_block_list.name: Djeeta
text_block_list.text:
Now that you're here, let's think through this together.
It's both of our futures in question, after all.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ねぇ、
あなたも一緒に悩んでくれるかな……
これから先、
私たちがどうするべきか……

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: The day after.
text_block_list.orig_text: ──翌日。

text_block_list.name: Djeeta
text_block_list.text: Hello.
text_block_list.orig_text: こんにちは。

text_block_list.name: Woman
text_block_list.text:
Oh, hello.
Seems like you made your decision, based on your expression.
Which way did the dice roll?
text_block_list.orig_text:
あら、
こんにちは。
その様子だと答えはもう出たみたいね。
聞かせてもらえるかしら？

text_block_list.name: Djeeta
text_block_list.text:
We did.
And well...
text_block_list.orig_text:
……はい。
私たちは……

text_block_list.name: Djeeta
text_block_list.text:
As much as we appreciate the offer, we've decided not to accept.
We're really sorry!
text_block_list.orig_text:
……あなたたちのギルドには、入れません。
せっかく誘ってくれたのに、ごめんなさい！

text_block_list.name: Djeeta
text_block_list.text:
But, well... We thought about it long and hard.
And this is the answer we're satisfied with.
text_block_list.orig_text:
これが……
たくさん考えて出した、
私たちの答えです！

text_block_list.name: Man
text_block_list.text: Do you mind if I ask why?
text_block_list.orig_text: 理由を聞かせてもらえるかな？

text_block_list.name: Djeeta
text_block_list.text:
It's my dad who inspired me to become a skyfarer.
I don't want to give up on that inspiration.
I want us to be as free as possible.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……やっぱり父さんみたいに、
私たちの騎空団で、
私たちだけの冒険がしたいんです。

text_block_list.name: Djeeta
text_block_list.text:
I want us to experience things in a way only we can.
It sounds super selfish, I know. But I just can't give up on that.
I can't give up on my dream!
text_block_list.orig_text:
これだけは、
どうしても諦められなくて……
わがままに聞こえるかもしれないんですけど、
それでもこれが、
私の夢だから……！

text_block_list.name: Woman
text_block_list.text:
You sound determined, at the very least.
What a bummer. It's not easy to find people like you two, 
you know.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……決意は固いみたいね。
残念だなぁ、
こんなにしっかりしてる子たちなんて、
そう見つからないのに。

text_block_list.name: Djeeta
text_block_list.text: I'm sorry...
text_block_list.orig_text: ごめんなさい……

text_block_list.name: Man
text_block_list.text:
Hey now, don't sweat it!
We've been all over the place at this point, so trust me. 
We're used to it.
text_block_list.orig_text:
おいおい、あんまり気にするな！
あちこちを旅してる俺たちにとっては、
よくあることなんだ。

text_block_list.name: Woman
text_block_list.text:
You took the time to think it through properly, though.
We appreciate that a lot more than you know.
text_block_list.orig_text:
でも真剣に考えてくれて嬉しかったわ。
本当にありがとう。

text_block_list.name: Djeeta
text_block_list.text: Thank you. Your offer meant a lot to us, too.
text_block_list.orig_text:
こちらこそ、
誘ってもらえて嬉しかったです！

text_block_list.name: Woman
text_block_list.text:
I do wish we could work together, but well,
there's little sense in trying to force it. You've got your
dreams and aspirations, so let us cheer you on, at the very least.
text_block_list.orig_text:
二人と一緒にやっていけないのは本当に残念だけど、
譲れないものがあるのなら、
仕方ないわ。
あなたの夢、
叶うといいわね。

text_block_list.name: Djeeta
text_block_list.text: Thank you! I hope things work out for you, too!
text_block_list.orig_text:
はい！　
　
ありがとうございます！

text_block_list.name: Woman
text_block_list.text: We'll be off, then. Here's hoping we meet again someday!
text_block_list.orig_text:
それじゃあね。
縁があったらまた会いましょう！

text_block_list.name: Djeeta
text_block_list.text:
And off they go.
Hey. Are you really fine with this?
text_block_list.orig_text:
……行っちゃったね。
あなたは、
これで良かったの？

text_block_list.name: Djeeta
text_block_list.text: If anything, it would make sense for you to go with them.
choice_data_list: I've only got one leader. And her name is Djeeta.
text_block_list.orig_text:
やっぱりあなたは、
あの人たちと一緒に行ったほうが……

text_block_list.name: Djeeta
text_block_list.text:
Oh, you! Thanks. Don't forget, though.
I was only able to reach this conclusion thanks to you.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ありがとう……！　
あなたが一緒にいてくれたから、
自分の気持ちに迷わないで答えが出せたんだ。

text_block_list.name: Djeeta
text_block_list.text:
This isn't about me anymore.
Your memories are the priority now.
If I want my dreams to come true, then that's down to me.
text_block_list.orig_text:
私の願いや夢を叶えるためだけじゃなくて、
あなたの記憶も取り戻さないと。
団員の願いを叶えるのも、
団長の務めだもん。

text_block_list.name: Djeeta
text_block_list.text: So yeah. Let's give it all we've got. Together.
text_block_list.orig_text:
これからも一緒に、
二人で頑張っていこうね。

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
Sharing a firm handshake, {0} and Djeeta
swore to give their all for their future.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ジータと{0}は、握手を交わし、
今後も二人で頑張っていこうと誓い合った。
